Convert validated comparison or ranking data to a long table

Source: R/data_tables.R
data_tables.Rd

Pairwise data become winner, loser, count rows, including zero counts but excluding the diagonal. Ranking data become ranking, position, item rows, containing only reported positions. An unreported item in a top-m ranking is below every reported item, but its exact position is unknown. These ordinary data frames can be passed to tibble::as_tibble().

Usage

# S3 method for class 'btsbm_pairwise_data'
as.data.frame(x, row.names = NULL, optional = FALSE, ...)

# S3 method for class 'btsbm_ranking_data'
as.data.frame(x, row.names = NULL, optional = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

x

Validated data from as_bt_data() or as_rankings().

row.names

Optional row names for the returned data frame.

optional, ...

Passed to base::as.data.frame().

Value

A data frame in long format.

Examples

comparisons <- tennis_toy()
head(as.data.frame(comparisons))
#>       winner    loser count
#> 1   Baseline      Ace     3
#> 2 Crosscourt      Ace     3
#> 3   Dropshot      Ace     2
#> 4      Elite      Ace     1
#> 5   Forehand      Ace     0
#> 6        Ace Baseline     5
head(as.data.frame(sushi_toy()))
#>     ranking position          item
#> 1 Ranking_1        1 cucumber_roll
#> 2 Ranking_1        2           egg
#> 3 Ranking_1        3    sea_urchin
#> 4 Ranking_1        4        shrimp
#> 5 Ranking_1        5          tuna
#> 6 Ranking_2        1         squid
